timeline.event: Simulation begins. Ipv4NetworkConfigurator assigns all IP addresses. RIP/OSPF routers start neighbor discovery. TrafficGen waits for startTime.
All 12 hosts begin sending 512-byte UDP packets to appServer (10.0.0.2:5000). Baseline PDR and end-to-end delay measurements begin.

LinkController calls: seRouter.ethg$o[0].disconnect() — seRouter -> coreRouter severed coreRouter.ethg$o[0].disconnect() — coreRouter -> seRouter severed
Expected behavior per protocol: - STATIC : seHost1-3 packets dropped immediately (no alternate route). Other departments unaffected. - RIP : Link failure detected when update timer expires (~30s). seHost1-3 lose connectivity until RIP reconverges (~t=90s worst case). - OSPF : Neighbor declared dead after deadInterval=40s (by ~t=100s). SPF recalculation runs immediately. Reconverges by ~t=100-105s. Faster recovery than RIP.

LinkController recreates cDatarateChannel (100Mbps, 2ms, PER=0.001) and calls: seOut->connectTo(coreIn, ch1); ch1->callInitialize(); coreOut->connectTo(seIn, ch2); ch2->callInitialize();
Expected behavior per protocol: - STATIC : Physical layer restored; seHost1-3 resume immediately. - RIP : New LSA broadcast; full convergence within one update interval (30s). Traffic resumes by ~t=150s. - OSPF : LSA flood on link-up; SPF within helloInterval (10s). Traffic resumes by ~t=130s.
All TrafficGen senders stop. Final scalars recorded: packetsSent, packetsReceived, PDR_%.
Simulation ends. Results written to results/ folder. Open .vec/.sca files in OMNeT++ Analysis Tool to compare PDR and endToEndDelay across all six configurations.

failureScenario.observationGuide: 1. Filter event log by "linkController" to confirm fail/recover messages. 2. Filter by "seRouter" — watch packetDropped spike at t=60s. 3. For RIP: search "rip" entries for route invalidation after t=60s. 4. For OSPF: search "ospf" for LSA flood starting ~t=60-100s. 5. Plot endToEndDelay:vector for seHost* — gap width = outage duration. 6. Compare PDR_% scalars: OSPF_CBR should have highest PDR for seHosts, Static_CBR lowest (no recovery), RIP_CBR in between.
